instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Check a person's answers against a saved form and, when they are all valid, record them with the score and segment they earn and any follow-up the form hands to its owner", and give it form_id (The saved form to answer); respondent_id (Who is answering; answers of one respondent group together); answers (Each question's answer, keyed by questionId).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:submit-form-answers and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give form_id, respondent_id and answers (questionId to value), and optionally submission_id (for a form answered again and again, so each time is kept) and answered_at.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: question-sequence (records:read); score-rule (records:list); segment-rule (records:list); follow-up-sequence (records:list); answer-fact (records:write); segment-assignment (records:write); owner-action-request (records:write).
